verification_notes: Europa Press reports that Telefónica completed the sale of Gran Vía 28 to Tomás Olivo and that the deed was executed on 1 September 2026.
Cinco Días reports the transaction at 200 million euros, while Europa Press reports a figure below 200 million euros; the exact price therefore remains unresolved.
The Madrid City Council identifies Gran Vía 28 as a Level 1, Singular Grade protected building and dates the building to 1926-1929.
Telefónica's own materials confirm the historical identity of Gran Vía 28 and its continued association with Fundación Telefónica.
The article excludes the disputed exact price and unverified future-use claims from factual assertions.
No certification is granted because explicit human editorial approval and a publication-gate decision are still required.
open_issues: Exact transaction price remains unresolved because published reports conflict between 200 million euros and below 200 million euros.
